listing.name: Project Solace (Discord only for now)
listing.summary: Contents: Solace faction with some niches focused on firepower and suppression.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Solace and Enmity factions, exploration content, and superweapons.

description: Introduces the Solace faction focused on firepower and suppression, and the Enmity faction focused on beams and fighters. Includes new ships, encounters, and superweapons that can be traded for at high reputation with the main Solace planet.
